object_description: narrow three-story addition with a compact rectangular volume
design_condition: The additional volume follows the existing slender-building rhythm along the northeastern slope edge, preserving the flowing landscape and southeast open space while improving the entrance forecourt.

positive.statement: The new building is logically derived from the existing structure and preserves the quality of the flowing landscape.

position.rationale: The elongated diagonal addition is clearly visible and aligned with the open landscape around it.

positive.statement: The interventions in the existing substance are limited to a minimum and integrate into the protected building structure.

position.rationale: Existing-structure interventions are approximated toward the northeastern end of the addition.

positive.statement: The simple, axially symmetrical floor plans offer good flexibility and appropriation options.

position.rationale: The narrow regular volume provides the visible anchor for the described floor-plan organization.

positive.statement: Combining the day and all-day school in one building has interesting operational advantages.

position.rationale: Operational advantages are assigned to the single visible addition rather than a separate locatable system.

positive.statement: The structure and floor plans are clean and efficient.

position.rationale: The regular upper-middle portion of the addition best represents its efficient organization.

negative.statement: The new building undesirably obscures the existing complex.

position.rationale: The visibility concern is anchored at the northeastern end facing the implied existing complex.

negative.statement: Clusters with more than two classes can only be formed to a limited extent.

position.rationale: Cluster formation is a floor-plan issue assigned to the central portion of the narrow addition.

negative.statement: The stairwell offers hardly any spatial qualities and does not meet fire-protection requirements.

position.rationale: The stairwell is not distinguishable, so it is approximated within the central circulation zone.

negative.statement: The underground gymnasium has insufficient natural lighting and negative static and economic effects.

position.rationale: The underground room is placed beneath the central footprint at the lowest sampled level.

negative.statement: The small window proportion calls achievement of the energy requirements into question.

position.rationale: Window proportions are unresolved in the point cloud; the upper eastern facade is a constrained anchor.
